"Create a professional, realistic 3D car racing game for Android mobile.

GAME FEATURES:

1. Full-screen landscape gameplay.
2. High-quality realistic 3D sports car with detailed body, glass, headlights, wheels and reflections.
3. Large realistic 3D racing highway with multiple lanes.
4. Beautiful open-world environment with trees, buildings, bridges, street lights and mountains.
5. Smooth mobile steering controls with left and right buttons.
6. Accelerate, brake and nitro buttons on the right side.
7. Realistic car physics, suspension, acceleration, braking and drifting.
8. Third-person chase camera that smoothly follows the player's car.
9. AI traffic cars with realistic movement.
10. Realistic collision detection and crash effects.
11. Speedometer, distance counter, score and nitro meter.
12. Engine sound, tire screech and collision sound.
13. High-quality lighting, shadows and realistic road textures.
14. Start menu, pause menu, restart and game over screen.
15. Optimize performance for Android mobile devices.

IMPORTANT:
Build a fully playable 3D car racing game, not a static scene or 2D game. All buttons must work correctly. Maintain smooth controls and stable camera movement. Use professional game-development quality.

---
This is a build request. Build a complete, playable game now (or apply the requested change to the existing game). Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and note them briefly when you finish.

Screenshots for your own checks: save small JPEGs (a .jpg path, viewport at most 1280px wide) and read only the latest one; older images are dropped from context. Read a full-size PNG only when fine detail matters.
"

content.text:
Implemented a playable mobile-friendly 3D racing game in `index.html`.

It includes a chase camera, scrolling highway and scenery, AI traffic, steering, accelerate/brake/nitro controls, collision damage, HUD, engine/crash/tire sounds, and start, pause, and restart flows. It requests fullscreen landscape mode on supported mobile browsers. Keyboard steering and acceleration are also available on desktop.

**Verification:** Confirmed the scene renders in-browser, the pause menu opens, and the JavaScript passes a syntax check. The game uses procedural 3D geometry and the Three.js CDN; it’s a browser game, not a packaged native Android APK, and the car/environment are not imported photorealistic assets.

Run it with a static server, for example: `python3 -m http.server 3002`.
